title: TechBridge Landing Page
description: Build a responsive landing page that introduces TechBridge and communicates the program clearly.
details: Focus on semantic HTML, responsive CSS, clear sections, navigation and a strong call to action.

title: Multi-page Website
description: Expand the TechBridge experience into a connected set of pages with consistent navigation and styling.
details: Create reusable visual patterns across pages and make sure links, layout and responsive behavior work together.

title: Interactive JavaScript Features
description: Add meaningful client-side interactions that make the website feel like a working product.
details: Use DOM selection, events, conditional logic and dynamic content instead of relying only on static HTML.

title: Responsive Design
description: Make the TechBridge website usable and visually consistent on desktop, tablet and mobile screens.
details: Pay attention to navigation, spacing, typography, cards, buttons and content flow at smaller breakpoints.

title: Challenge Hub
description: Build a hub where interns can explore focused challenges and practise frontend skills.
details: Organise challenges clearly, provide useful descriptions and connect the hub to the wider TechBridge website.

title: Interactive Intern Dashboard
description: Create this dashboard for tracking internship progress, tasks, technologies and challenges.
details: Generate tasks from JavaScript data, calculate progress, filter statuses, open task details and switch technology information without refreshing.

title: Modern Web Technologies
description: Explore frontend frameworks and backend technologies used to build complete modern platforms.
details: Research and explain Next.js, Vue.js, Angular and backend technologies such as Node.js, Express.js, Django, Flask, Laravel and .NET.

title: Final Integration & Polish
description: Bring the internship work together, test the experience and prepare the project for submission.
details: Check navigation, responsiveness, accessibility, JavaScript behaviour, project organisation and the overall quality of the finished platform.
